text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: She was pretty good in the February Stakes, but what are the odds of her actually winning today?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: If she does manage to win and follow through on her declaration, I'd say she's the real deal. I guess we'll see…

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan A
text_block_list.text: Sorry, couldn't help but overhear your conversation, and let me tell you—Falco is the real deal! Have you seen all her races?!

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan A
text_block_list.text: If you haven't, then take a look at this! It's an official montage of all her races.

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan A
text_block_list.text: Right?! Here, now check her out onstage!

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Um, sorry to bother you, but… I'm looking forward to running with you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The younger students are super nice. Look at them, taking the time to say hello! ☆
choice_data_list: Well, aren't you quite the matriarch.
Well, aren't you quite the matriarch.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Now, hold on a second! I'm still young and spry!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …Well, I do have a lot of experience, being in senior year and all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I was just thinking about how it's up to me to blaze a trail for the next generation.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: A trail that younger runners will want to follow all the way out here, onto the dirt.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I want to make a reality where everyone dreams of racing on dirt.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win this for all the younger students who look up to me!
